svg.title: Example of answering Luca by number and confirming, on sample data
svg.text: Answer in your own words or by number.
Luca shows exactly what it will change,
then learns the address for next time.

text.tspan: 1. Label the USDC transfer from 0x1a2b…9f3c (on Oct 9, $250.00)
2. Label the USDC payment to 0x7d4e…06ab (on Oct 9, $56.65) as
- Labeled the USDC transfer from 0x1a2b…9f3c (on Oct 9,
- Labeled the USDC payment to 0x7d4e…06ab (on Oct 9, $56.65)
New transfers with this address will be labeled the same way.
